# sdwan_service_dual_router_ha_feature (Data Source)

This data source can read the Service Dual Router HA Feature.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sdwan_service_dual_router_ha_feature" "example" {
  id                 = "f6b2c44c-693c-4763-b010-895aa3d236bd"
  feature_profile_id = "f6dd22c8-0b4f-496c-9a0b-6813d1f8b8ac"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `feature_profile_id` (String) Feature Profile ID

### Optional

- `id` (String) The id of the Feature
- `name` (String) The name of the Feature

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) The description of the Feature
- `enable_optimize_paths` (Boolean) The operation mode is configured for each router in 2 configuration groups
- `redundancy_groups` (Attributes Set) Service VPN Id List (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--redundancy_groups))
- `version` (Number) The version of the Feature

<a id="nestedatt--redundancy_groups"></a>
### Nested Schema for `redundancy_groups`

Read-Only:

- `group_id` (Number)
- `tag_name` (String)
- `vpn_ids` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--redundancy_groups--vpn_ids))

<a id="nestedatt--redundancy_groups--vpn_ids"></a>
### Nested Schema for `redundancy_groups.vpn_ids`

Read-Only:

- `vpn_id` (String)
